# googleworkspace_group_settings (Resource)

Manages the posting and visibility settings of a Google Workspace group via the Groups Settings API.

The group itself is managed by `googleworkspace_group`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "googleworkspace_group" "announcements" {
  email = "announcements@example.com"
  name  = "Announcements"
}

resource "googleworkspace_group_settings" "announcements" {
  email                   = googleworkspace_group.announcements.email
  who_can_view_membership = "ALL_MANAGERS_CAN_VIEW"
  who_can_post_message    = "ALL_OWNERS_CAN_POST"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String)

### Optional

- `message_moderation_level` (String)
- `who_can_post_message` (String)
- `who_can_view_membership` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the group's email address.
terraform import googleworkspace_group_settings.announcements announcements@example.com
```
